No live workflow uses a path filter, so there is no live instance of a filter excluding a file the gate claims to protect. Live miss count is 0 because filters are absent, not because the evaluator skipped the directory. AUD-0041 inventoried 7 workflows with trigger names only; paths / paths-ignore were not captured there. The evaluator is not blind: the required control fires — fixture-control-miss paths-ignore excludes protected/secret.py and the matcher reports that miss. A second fixture (paths: src/**) also misses protected/secret.py. Probe 2's ledger agrees: a secret-only commit does not run the ignore-filter gate, an app-only commit still does, and a mixed commit still does. Recorded AUD-0041 Actions run 31525279780 is the live-estate receipt that quality.yml executed; a fresh gh file-to-run join is unavailable on this checkout.
